faq.q: What is the Cekat.AI operations solution?
faq.a: Automation that turns conversations into processes: orders recorded from chat, shipping calculated, tickets created and routed, notifications sent to the right team, and every step visible in one place.
Order capture from chat, shipping cost calculation, ticket creation and routing, cross-team notifications, status follow-ups, and any flow you compose yourself with no-code workflow automation.

faq.q: How does automatic shipping calculation work?
faq.a: The customer mentions an address, the AI quotes rates for Indonesia's major couriers right in the conversation, and the number is recorded on the order. No courier tabs, no manual lookup.

faq.q: Can it connect to systems we already use?
faq.a: Yes, through APIs and webhooks, so orders and statuses can flow into internal systems, and internal systems can trigger outbound messages from Cekat.AI.

faq.q: What about steps that need a human decision?
faq.a: Automation can pause at approval points: a ticket waits for confirmation, then continues once approved. Anything outside the pattern escalates to the team with full context.

faq.q: Do we have to automate everything at once?
faq.a: No. Most teams start with the single most time-consuming flow, order capture for example, then add more once the first one is proven.
From signup to a live bot is about 5 minutes. A first automation flow is usually done the same day, with no code.

faq.q: What happens when an automation fails?
faq.a: The failed step shows in the automation view along with where it stopped, so it can be fixed and re-run. You learn about it from the system rather than from a customer complaint.
